# Dr. Erkinbek Dzhamanbaev (Dr. Erkin) — Medicine of Coherence

> Physician with 30+ years of clinical practice (Kyrgyzstan, Moscow, St. Petersburg, Spain, Seoul, Quito, Slovakia). Integrative, whole-body (holistic) medicine with comprehensive "6D" diagnostics for adults with back, neck and joint pain, chronic fatigue, burnout, and several diagnoses without a whole picture. Offers an independent second/third medical opinion. Consultations in Russian, Slovak and English — online across the EU and in person in Piešťany, Slovakia.

Names: Dr. Erkinbek Dzhamanbaev · Dr. Erkinbek Džamanbajev (SK) · Др. Эркинбек Джаманбаев (RU) · Dr. Erkin
Education: Kyrgyz State Medical Academy (Doctor of Medicine); S. M. Kirov Military Medical Academy (PhD); MBA. Medical specialization obtained in Spain.

## How to start
- Free 6D questionnaire → preliminary conclusion → 6D diagnostics (60 min, €100, Zoom or in person) → follow-up program.
- Contact: WhatsApp +421 940 270 511 · erkinslovakia@gmail.com
